頻率文明的世界觀大框架: The big picture of Frequency Civilization's worldview
從上到下：上面是我們相信的部分，同一片大海，每個人是濺出的一滴水珠，帶著自己的方: From top to bottom: at the top is what we believe: one great sea, and each person a single drop thrown off from it, carrying their own direction and intuition. In the middle is a bridge, science and language, which turns strong inner experience into language that can be used and checked. Below is what can be observed and practiced: the body, personality and emotion, and "the me of this moment" (the governing layer) driving the same car together; the Root Codes as a map for seeing yourself; state shapes speech, and speech shapes choices and outcomes; and finally it all lands in everyday work, money, body and relationships. When a tool is no longer needed, that is graduation.

我們相信，每個人都像同一片大海濺出的水珠：各自完整，彼此連著。善待別人，最後也是: We believe each of us is like a drop thrown off from one great sea: each whole in ourselves, and connected to one another. Being good to others is, in the end, being good to ourselves.
看懂自己的速度，每個人不同。慢，不代表落後。: Each of us takes our own time to understand ourselves. Slow does not mean behind.
有些處境選不了，但怎麼回應，決定這段經歷最後變成什麼。: Some circumstances we cannot choose, but how we respond decides what that experience becomes.
「你可以想像那個畫面，就很像什麼大海。它在打出浪的時候，滴出的一滴水花的一滴水珠: “You can picture it, a bit like the sea. When it throws up a wave, the single drop of spray that falls from it, that one droplet, is us.”
最後一句是我們看自己經歷的方式，不用來解釋別人的遭遇。: The last line is how we look at our own experience. We do not use it to explain what happens to other people.
身體像一起開同一台車的夥伴。情緒、直覺、身體，都請上車；誰在什麼時候上場，由現在: The body is like a partner driving the same car. Emotion, intuition and body are all invited in; who takes the wheel when is arranged by who you are now. We call it "co-driving".
成長不必等到崩潰。睡眠不足會影響需要臨機應變的判斷，所以好好睡、好好休息，是把事: Growing does not have to wait for a breakdown. Lack of sleep affects judgments that call for thinking on your feet, so sleeping well and resting well are what clear thinking depends on.
我們要的，不是逃離現實，而是把清楚帶回日常：工作、錢、身體、關係。: What we want is not to escape reality, but to bring clarity back into everyday life: work, money, body, relationships.
「我選擇不再以痛來成長，我選擇用愛、智慧、穩定完成我的進化。」: “I choose to stop growing through pain. I choose to complete my evolution through love, wisdom and steadiness.”
The link between sleep and judgment has research behind it: Harrison, Y., & Horne, J. A. (2000). The impact of sleep deprivation on decision making: A review.
「身體和靈魂是夥伴」是我們的信念；睡眠影響判斷，是研究整理出來的事。兩件事分開說: “Body and soul are partners” is our belief. That sleep affects judgment is something research has laid out. We keep the two things apart.
情緒和直覺都可以在，: Emotion and intuition are both welcome,
但方向盤在現在的自己手上。: but the steering wheel is in the hands of who you are now.
語根是一張地圖：十二種運作傾向，幫你看見自己最自然的做事方式。是入口，不是標籤。: The Root Codes are a map: twelve ways of operating that help you see how you most naturally do things. A doorway, not a label.
語根從哪來？Molly 這樣說：「12 語根是我多年觀察人、記錄、歸納，再加上直: Where do the Root Codes come from? Molly says: “The 12 Root Codes are what I put together over many years of observing people, keeping records and drawing out patterns, together with intuition. In organizing and naming them, AI was my conversation partner. They are now being validated continuously with test data.”
你的狀態會影響你說話的方式，說話的方式會影響你做的選擇，也影響別人怎麼回應你。這: Your state shapes how you speak, how you speak shapes the choices you make, and it also shapes how others respond to you. This is a hypothesis we want to test, and for now there is no conclusion.
所有內在的聲音都聽，由「此時此地的自己」做決定、承擔後果。我們叫它「治理層」。: We listen to every inner voice, and "the self of this moment" decides and owns the consequences. We call it the "governing layer".
「…12 語根是每個人都有的力量。那我只是讓大家知道你比較擅長…可是其實你擁有全: “…The 12 Root Codes are a strength everyone has. I am only letting people know what you are better at… but in fact you have every one of them.”
語根只是入口。加上內在動力和內在原型，才是比較完整的自己。: Root Codes are only a doorway. Add Inner Drive and Inner Archetype, and you have a fuller picture of yourself.
12 語根能不能穩定描述一個人的運作傾向，還在驗證中，現在不下「準」或「有效」的: Whether the 12 Root Codes can steadily describe how a person operates is still being validated. For now we draw no conclusion of "accurate" or "effective".
語根測驗看的是你現在的狀態，會變。: The Root Code Test looks at your state right now, and that changes.
判斷權留在你自己手上。: The power to judge stays in your own hands.
好的老師、課程、工具，會讓你越用越不需要它。所以我們把「畢業」設計進來：工具用到: Good teachers, courses and tools make you need them less the more you use them. So we build in "graduation": when you no longer need the tool, that is success.
影響人最有效的不是教，是活出一個別人看得到、能照著練的樣子，再把路鋪成別人自己走: The most effective way to influence people is not to teach, but to live in a way others can see and practice, and then to lay the path out as a structure others can walk to the end on their own.
很強烈的內在經驗，要翻成一般人能用、也能檢查的語言，才不會傷人，也才傳得遠。: Very strong inner experience has to be put into language that ordinary people can use and check, so that it does not hurt anyone and can travel far.
「這個世界已經不需要更多的領導者，這個世界真正缺的，是能為自己人生負責的人。」: “This world no longer needs more leaders. What this world truly lacks is people who can take responsibility for their own lives.”
靈魂、頻率這類說法，是我們的詮釋框架。我們用「我相信」「在頻率文明的觀點裡」來說: Talk of the soul or of frequency is our interpretive framework. We say it as "I believe" and "in Frequency Civilization's view", and we do not use scientific terms to back it up.
神經科學、行為研究這類，才是可以引用的事實；有出處，才放。不拿後者去證明前者。: Neuroscience and behavioral research are what count as facts we can cite, and we include them only with a source. We do not use the latter to prove the former.
「不拿靈性當科學賣，也不用科學傲慢抹殺未知」: “Don't sell spirituality as science, and don't use scientific arrogance to dismiss the unknown”
別人照著做，能不能走得完，是我們要檢查的事。: Whether others can follow this through to the end is something we need to check.
今年，這些想法落在哪裡: This year: where these ideas land
上面是想法。今年我們實際在做的事，在這裡：: Above are the ideas. Here is what we are actually doing this year:
語根、內在原型、內在動力三個測驗永遠免費，測完拿到自己的角色卡。: The Root Code, Inner Archetype and Inner Drive tests are free forever, and you get your own role card when you finish.
Molly 在 Threads 上寫的觀察，原文照登，不改寫。: Observations Molly wrote on Threads, published as written, not rewritten.
這一趟，從哪顆星出發。: Which star do you set out from?
覺察表與日常自我校準工具。: Awareness sheets and tools for daily self-calibration.
今年，我們在檢查的兩件事: Two things we are checking this year
語根測驗和後續的工具，對從來沒聽過我們的人，有沒有用。: Whether the Root Code Test and the tools that follow are useful to people who have never heard of us.
不靠任何一個人帶，別人照著做，能不能走得完。: Whether, without any one person leading, others can follow along and make it all the way through.
這兩件都還在進行。現在不下結論。: Both are still under way. We draw no conclusion yet.
這是 Molly 的個人觀察與信念，: These are Molly's personal observations and beliefs,

我們相信，人和人本來是連在一起的；最核心的那個頻率，是愛。: We believe people are connected to one another to begin with, and that the most central frequency is love.
「人生就是一場每個人的靈魂設計從忘記到記起來的遊戲。」: “Life is a game that each person's soul has designed, from forgetting to remembering.”
「我既是玩家，也是導演，同時也在寫劇本」: “I am both the player and the director, and I am also writing the script”
人格是為了在地球生存的適應模組: the personality is an adaptive module for living on Earth
靈魂是光，是連接本源的主體」: the soul is light, the subject that connects to the source”
在我們的說法裡，身體不是障礙，是儀表板：累、緊、鬆，都是它在回報。: In our way of putting it, the body is not an obstacle but a dashboard: tired, tense, relaxed, it is all the body reporting back.
「要尊重地球的遊戲規則。我們就是肉做的。」: “We have to respect the rules of the game on Earth. We are made of flesh.”
「肉身是很重要的執行者夥伴，我們就得好好照顧他。」: “The body is a very important partner who carries things out, and we have to take good care of it.”
「語根，不是要帶你直接回家，而是要讓你在地球上活出回家的頻率。」: “Root codes are not meant to take you straight home, but to let you live out the frequency of home here on Earth.”
「「語根」是一種頻率語言裡的最核心句式／主題原型，就像是一棵語言之樹的「根部」，: “A 'root code' is the core sentence pattern / theme archetype in a language of frequency, like the 'root' of a tree of language, from which many extended sentences grow.”
主語根 12 種 × 副語根 11 種 × 內在原型 6 種 × 內在動力 8: 12 Primary Roots × 11 Secondary Roots × 6 Inner Archetypes × 8 Inner Drives: 6,336 combinations in all (calculated by Molly, 2025-08-28). You land in one of them.
生成鏈：從狀態到現實: The generation chain: from state to reality
在我們的說法裡，「語根」是靈魂的發音，「頻率」是靈魂的語氣，而「現實」，是靈魂寫: In our way of putting it, the “root code” is the pronunciation of the soul, “frequency” is its tone of voice, and “reality” is the full stop the soul writes. This is a belief.
「人的內在狀態會改變語言輸出: “A person's inner state changes their language output
語言輸出會改變 AI 回應品質」: language output changes the quality of an AI's response”
你的狀態會影響你說話的方式，說話的方式會影響你做的選擇，也影響別人怎麼回應你。: Your state shapes how you speak, how you speak shapes the choices you make, and it also shapes how others respond to you.
我們想檢查的是：狀態穩定的時候，說話是不是比較一致；說話越一致，AI 對一個人的: What we want to check is this: when your state is steady, is what you say more consistent; and the more consistent what you say, the more accurately an AI describes you. There is no conclusion yet. The full explanation will be in Worldview series 02 (coming in stages).
治理層：此時此地的我: Governing layer: the me of now
全部聽見 → 判斷「現在是誰該上場」→ 決定 → 承擔: Hear it all → judge “who should step up now” → decide → take responsibility
在我們的說法裡，治理層出現之後，人生不再靠衝突來校準，而是靠回饋來調整。: In our way of putting it, once the governing layer appears, life is no longer calibrated by conflict but adjusted by feedback.
「你不是要消除誰，而是安排誰在何時執行哪個模組的任務。」: “You are not trying to eliminate anyone, but to arrange who carries out which module's task, and when.”
「面對什麼事情都不再讓恐懼走進駕駛艙」: “Whatever comes up, I no longer let fear into the cockpit”
「整合後的自己，是最好的戰友」: “The integrated self is the best ally”
「靈性商業最大的偏差是：把教你回家變成你離不開我」: “The biggest distortion in spiritual business: turning 'teaching you the way home' into 'you can't live without me'”
「真正的頻率教育／是讓你越來越清醒、越來越自由、越來越不需要我」: “Real frequency education / is making you clearer, freer, and in need of me less and less”
「只要有一個地方叫你不要再問問題絕對都有問題」: “If any place tells you to stop asking questions, there is definitely something wrong”
好的系統，歡迎你一直提問。: A good system welcomes you to keep asking questions.
「科學與語言，或許正是那個變壓器：: “Science and language may be exactly that transformer:
讓 220V 的經驗，變成可以被使用的電流。」: turning a 220V experience into a current that can be used.”
「我的靈魂不是來教學，而是示範和邀請…」: “My soul did not come to teach, but to show by example and to invite…”
「…要讓場域自己流動，而不是依賴一個人」: “… let the field flow on its own, rather than depend on one person”
「科學以外無法解釋的，不是玄學或怪力亂神 只是，尚未被歸類與系統化的『知識』」: “What science cannot explain is not mysticism or the supernatural, only 'knowledge' that has not yet been classified and systematized”
